account.description: The payee's bank and account, masked to its last four digits.

amount.description: What the line pays, in SGD.

bank_detail_version.description: The version of the bank-detail record the line was made from (FR-PPL-14).

instruction_id.description: The instruction ID the release gave it.

line_id.description: Nemura's ID of the payment line.

line_version.description: The line's version: a revised line is a new version, and the batch is approved again.

needs_bic.description: True when Fyniq does not know this line's bank's BIC: fill it in when preparing the batch (bank_bics on prepareSalaryBatch), or the batch cannot be asked for approval.

person_id.description: The person of the employee projection.

person_name.description: The person's display name in the projection.

state.description: Where the payment is (FR-PPL-12): paid only from the bank feed matching the debit or a person's record with evidence.

waiting.description: Why the line is not released now: held for tax clearance, Nemura did not say whether it is held, the person's bank details changed, or an unknown outcome blocks a new instruction.
